description:
We’re a student team developing ETHIODROUGHT — Beyond Rainfall for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, using AI and NASA satellite data to study drought and environmental change in Ethiopia.

With backgrounds in Python, ML, and software development, we’re looking for motivated teammates interested in Earth/environmental science, agriculture, GIS, data science, statistics, or web dev. No expertise needed, just curiosity, teamwork, and commitment to turning satellite data into real-world impact!
